Learn the cost of a deployable future policy first, then compare actions using only the current causal state.

text.tspan: The stop branch depends on estimated belief quality; it is not a certified error bound. Current-step costs are added once; later policy costs belong inside .

g.text: Frozen-policy rollouts produce realized costs; regress their conditional expectation.
Labels supervise training targets only; never choose the per-event hindsight minimum.
Default: a declared fixed band. Optional cheap birth head
predicts opening cost from own/shared backbone features.
